name: hyperuuid-python-wasm-smoke-test
description: Proves the Rust core, built as an Emscripten side module, loads and runs correctly inside a real Pyodide (CPython-to-WASM) session via plain ctypes.CDLL — the exact mechanism hyperuuid's own _runtime.py already uses natively. See README.md in this directory for how to build the artifact this test loads.
